assets.video.signal.field_order[0].matched: field 1 dominance (§2.1.4) — field 1 dominance is the standard broadcast term for top-field-first

assets.video.signal.mains_frequency_hz.note: Norway is a 50Hz mains territory; not a number the document itself states.

assets.audio.codec.allowed[0].matched: all audio tracks must be encoded as PCM with a sample rate of 48kHz at a depth of 24bits/sample (§4.6)

assets.audio.track_count.min.matched: HD files must contain a group of either 4 or 16 tracks (§4.6.1)
assets.audio.track_count.min.note: the document requires a FIXED total of 4 or 16 tracks, not a continuous 2-8 range. The current min=2/max=8 doesn't match either discrete option and would incorrectly also pass e.g. a 6-track file. UMDP's track_count schema (min/max/exact) can't cleanly express 'exactly 4 OR exactly 16' -- flagged for a human/schema decision rather than silently forcing a wrong min/max.

assets.audio.language.mode.matched: must only be used for programmes with single language soundtracks (§4.6.1, R48:2a/R123:4b/4c/16c note)

assets.audio.layout.allowed_layouts[0].matched: St. Final Mix L / St. Final Mix R (R48:2a stereo layout, §4.6.1 table)

assets.audio.loudness.standards[0].name.matched: must comply with the EBU Recommendation EBU R128 (§3.1)

assets.audio.loudness.standards[0].juris.note: categorical fact about NRK's market (Norway), not a value the document states.

assets.audio.loudness.true_peak_max.matched: -3dBTP recommended ... failed QC if level exceeds -1dBTP

assets.audio.sync.max_offset_ms.matched: AV sync timing through the audio desk to the point of delivery should be ±5ms (§6.7.4)
assets.audio.sync.max_offset_ms.note: the only explicit ±5ms figure in the doc is for live AV-sync checking (§6.7.4), not file-delivery sync specifically -- close enough to record as model, flagged for review.
